instruction: Navigate to https://developer.apple.com/design/human-interface-guidelines/searching and save the main content section about 'Best practices' as a document named "search_guidelines.docx" on the desktop. Include only the best practices bullet points.

command: import pyautogui; import time; pyautogui.hotkey('ctrl', 's'); time.sleep(0.5);

metadata.explanation: Task requires navigating to Apple HIG search page and extracting best practices content. Evaluator checks for key terms related to search guidelines and ensures document has substantial content (min 50 chars). Similar difficulty to original - both require web navigation and content extraction to .docx format.

llm_judge_reasons: Keyword validation is too generic - ['search', 'best', 'practice'] could match any search-related content, not specifically Apple HIG best practices
No verification that content is from the specified URL (https://developer.apple.com/design/human-interface-guidelines/searching)
No verification that ONLY best practices bullet points are included (instruction requires exclusion of other content)
Minimum length of 50 characters is too low - a single sentence could pass, doesn't ensure substantial best practices content was extracted
No structural validation that content is formatted as bullet points as required
Evaluator would give false positives to incorrect implementations (e.g., random text with those keywords, content from wrong webpage, content with extra sections)
llm_judge_fix_suggestions: Add more specific keywords unique to Apple HIG best practices (e.g., 'user', 'interface', 'guidelines', specific terms from the actual best practices section)
Increase min_length to a realistic value (e.g., 200-300 characters minimum for best practices content)
Add keyword exclusion check to ensure content doesn't contain terms from other sections (e.g., 'overview', 'anatomy', 'developer') if instruction requires only best practices
Consider adding structure validation to check for bullet point markers or list formatting
Add domain-specific validation keywords that would only appear in Apple's HIG documentation
